derivedFrom: crystal-graphite-sheet-nih.glb (see sibling crystal-graphite-sheet-nih.license.json for the original, un-fixed source's own sidecar)
componentMapping: chemistry > crystal-structures > Graphite (single graphene sheet, planar hexagonal covalent lattice) -- material-fixed derivative wired into ChemistryLab.tsx's Crystal Structures mode (Wave 11), fills part of Gap B from docs/assets/chemistry-structure.md (bonus: carbon allotrope comparison -- diamond vs graphite). This model is a single graphene sheet, not stacked multi-layer graphite -- kept correctly labeled throughout the app's Crystal Structures mode copy.
underlyingStructureData: Parametric OpenSCAD honeycomb model of a graphite sheet (graphene layer), hexagonal lattice, per-entry description: "STL and parametric OpenSCAD model of a graphite sheet (a.k.a graphene)... amount of honeycomb structures generated can be specified in the input parameters."
creator: heinonj (juha.heinonen@aalto.fi, Aalto University)
attributionText: "Graphite sheet parametric model" by heinonj (Juha Heinonen), NIH 3D (3d.nih.gov, entry 3DPX-008098). Licensed CC-BY 4.0.
redistributionStatus: Permitted with attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Confirmed via NIH 3D entry page license badge linking to the CC-BY 4.0 deed. Same license chain as the original source file -- the material fix below only added a PBR material, it did not change provenance or licensing; the CC-BY attribution requirement is unchanged and still applies to this derivative.
downloadedVariant: Graphite sheet_NIH3D.glb (the entry's .glb output; .stl/.wrl/.x3d/.scad variants also exist on the entry and were not downloaded). This file is the material-fixed derivative of that download, produced by scripts/assets/fix-crystal-materials.mjs -- see docs/assets/reviews/crystal-material-fix.md.

validation.generator: https://github.com/mikedh/trimesh (STL-to-GLB conversion of a 3D-printable parametric model, not an authored-for-web asset), plus scripts/assets/fix-crystal-materials.mjs (added one glTF-core PBR material, 'graphite-sheet-dark', to the existing mesh primitive -- geometry/BIN chunk untouched, re-verified byte-identical to source)

approxBoundingBox.units: millimeters (source was authored as a physical 3D-print parametric model; not normalized to app scene units)
approxBoundingBox.note: Unchanged from the un-fixed source's bounding box -- the material fix pass never touches geometry/accessors, only adds a material and points the mesh primitive at it. Wide flat sheet aspect ratio -- ChemistryLab.tsx's CrystalViewer computes a per-model camera fit rather than assuming a cube-ish extent, to keep this fully in frame.

reviewNote: Wave 7 (docs/assets/reviews/crystal-material-fix.md) added a near-black opaque metallic-sheen material (baseColorFactor [0.09,0.09,0.1,1.0], metallicFactor 0.55, roughnessFactor 0.32, double-sided). Not modified by the Wave 9 diamond-only contrast pass. Wave 8 visual review (docs/reviews/wave8-crystals-branchlab.md) rendered this derivative and found it PASS -- near-black opaque material with visible sheen, unmistakable flat honeycomb sheet confirmed edge-on, most visually distinct of the trio, no clipping at any angle. Wired into modelRegistry.ts and ChemistryLab.tsx's Crystal Structures mode in Wave 11; requires the in-app CC-BY attribution line noted above.
